The '''Star Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Sommin City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]]. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] were held hostage in the penthouse by pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]].
